name: Oregon 4-H Summer Conference
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Spend four days on the OSU campus in workshops taught by OSU faculty and 4-H volunteers. Meet teens from across Oregon and explore careers and college.
who_can_apply: Oregon 7th to 12th graders. You do not have to be a 4-H member.
pay_detail: $275 registration fee plus a bus fee if you ride the bus. Financial assistance and transportation help are available through your local 4-H program.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened May 15, 2026. Next year not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online when registration opens (about mid-May). Choose your workshops when you register. Watch for emails from your county 4-H program about financial help.
notes: 2026 dates were June 24 to 27 and registration opened May 15, 2026 at 3:00 pm. Buses leave from several Oregon towns for an added fee. 2027 dates not posted.
